blocks.text: Luke’s prayer in verses 1–4 is shorter than the form in Matthew in the earliest recoverable text. Some manuscripts expand Luke’s wording in ways that make it resemble Matthew more closely. This means that differing printed forms of the prayer may reflect later harmonizing expansions rather than Luke’s original wording.

Luke presents Jonah as a sign to the Ninevites and emphasizes their response to Jonah’s proclamation. Matthew’s related account includes an explicit comparison involving three days and nights as well as Nineveh’s response. Reading Luke on its own terms keeps the focus here on the sign of Jonah and the response called forth by his proclamation.
